incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty: HIGH urgency — p99 latency alert for /v1/generate (eu-west) — triggered 1769543210. Pager: oncall-duty. Autopage: true.

Ana (oncall): acked — I'm on it.

Ana (oncall): seeing p95->p99 jump across multiple pods, tail latency skyrocketing.

Devin (infra): checking autoscaler metrics now. Can you paste the alert chart?

Ana (oncall): https://metrics.internal/redwood/alerts/1769543210 — spike started ~1769543150, CPU fine, GPU utilization steady, queue depth rising.

Sam (sre): queue depth rising suggests enqueueing at proxy/batcher. Any recent deploys?

Ana (oncall): no prod deploys in last hour. We had a config change to default batch_timeout from 12ms -> 50ms in eu-west at 1759000000 for an experiment. Could be related.

Devin (infra): that would increase batching delay — should reduce requests/sec but increase per-request latency if small requests wait. But p99 jump with queue depth rising... might be backpressure between front proxy and runtime.

Karen (product-ops): any customer-facing impact? We have a few live chats in EU complaining about slowness.

Ana (oncall): initial alert shows 12% of requests > 2s in the window. Not yet widespread but definitely impacting interactive flows.

pagerduty-bot: PagerDuty incident created: INC-2026-4532. Priority: P1.

Sam (sre): Runbook step 1: confirm autoscaler not saturating. ps: run rictl autoscaler status.

Devin (infra): running now.

Devin (infra): ```
$ rictl autoscaler status --region eu-west --pool infer-workers
replicas: 8 (min:2 max:20)
avg_queue_depth: 48
scaling_events: none
```

Sam (sre): replicas look ok, avg queue depth 48 is high. Suggest immediate mitigation: temporarily bump min replicas and reduce batch_timeout in prod for eu-west.

Ana (oncall): I can change batch_timeout quickly. Should I revert experiment to 12ms?

Devin (infra): yes revert batch_timeout to 12ms and bump min replicas to 12 for the pool. I'll apply scaling change.

Ana (oncall): applying batch_timeout revert now.

Ana (oncall): ```
# route-config api
PATCH /v1/configs/eu-west/batcher
{"batch_timeout_ms":12}
```

Ana (oncall): reverted batch_timeout. Watching metrics...

Devin (infra): bumping pool min replicas: ```
$ rictl pool update infer-workers --min 12 --region eu-west
```

Devin (infra): done. New replicas converging.

Sam (sre): good — I'm seeing queue depth drop from 48 -> 12 in the last 30s. p95/p99 trending down.

Karen (product-ops): update for ops: impacted endpoints: /v1/generate interactive chat in eu-west; estimated 8%-12% of active sessions had >1s extra latency during spike. We're posting a brief status note to status.redwood.ai.

Ana (oncall): confirmed p99 fell from ~3.6s -> ~0.85s after changes. p95 ~120ms.

Sam (sre): next steps: create short RCA ticket. Tagging infra to review why batch_timeout experiment didn't roll back automatically. Also need to add a synthetic test for interactive tail latency when batch_timeout > 20ms.

Devin (infra): I'll open INF-2026-78 for autoscaler sensitivity and a guardrail to block batch_timeout > 30ms for interactive routes.

Karen (product-ops): I'll coordinate comms — updating the status page and notifying the small set of affected customers who reported slowness.

Ana (oncall): anybody want the handoff? I'm staying for 15 more minutes to observe, then I'll hand to next oncall.

Sam (sre): I'll take the handoff in 20. Please include notes: reverted batch_timeout, increased min replicas, follow-ups INF-2026-78.

Ana (oncall): adding runbook note and timeline to the incident ticket.

Ana (oncall): timeline snippet: "1769543150 - tail latency rising; 1769543210 - pager fired; 1769543230 - batch_timeout reverted; 1769543250 - pool min replicas set to 12; 1769543310 - p99 receded."

Devin (infra): leaving a command snippet in the ticket: ```
# quick rollback
rictl configs set eu-west batcher batch_timeout_ms=12
rictl pool update infer-workers --min 12
```

Sam (sre): marking incident as mitigated in PagerDuty and adding a follow-up postmortem task. Please continue monitoring for 30m.

pagerduty-bot: PagerDuty: INC-2026-4532 status -> Mitigated by Ana (oncall).

Karen (product-ops): thanks team. Notifying customers and drafting RCA blurb.

Ana (oncall): handing off to Sam in 20. I'll DM him the dashboard links.

Sam (sre): ack — taking watch. Thanks all.

incident-bot: Note: please file post-incident review within 72h and link INF-2026-78. Recommended labels: latency, autoscaler, batcher, eu-west.
